query: SELECT s.id, s.name, s.sector, s.stage, s.priority, GROUP_CONCAT(sv.ventureId) as ventureIds FROM spvs s LEFT JOIN spv_ventures sv ON sv.spvId = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.sector, s.stage, s.priority LIMIT 20;
